## What this does

Describe the change in three sentences or fewer.

## How it affects the instrument

State explicitly what changes about the *sound*, *visual*, or *interaction*. If none of those change, say so.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if browser behaviour changed)

## Documentation

- [ ] README / ARCHITECTURE updated, if the system-level explanation changed.
- [ ] `docs/technical`, `docs/design`, or `docs/development` updated, if subsystem detail changed.
- [ ] No documentation change required.

## Conceptual guardrail

If this change alters the instrument's tone, palette, determinism, or interaction, explain why the change belongs inside the existing creative system rather than steering it into a different project.
